disease_label_per_paper: Takayasu arteritis presenting with ischemic stroke
presentation_summary: Sudden right-sided body weakness, left facial deviation, slurred speech, and transient loss of consciousness.
History included prolonged low-grade fever, unquantified weight loss, easy fatigability, and left arm pain while combing hair.
Exam showed right arm BP 155/96 mmHg, left arm BP 140/87 mmHg, oxygen saturation 93% on room air, weaker left radial pulse, faint right foot pulses, and bilateral carotid bruits.
Labs showed hemoglobin 9.2 g/dL and ESR 94 mm/h with normal renal function and negative ANA/RF/VDRL.
Carotid Doppler and CT showed carotid wall thickening, left common carotid occlusion/thrombus, aortic arch dilation, and descending/abdominal aortic wall thickening and narrowing.
